I really enjoyed my visit to this clinic , I was here today. I did the tests recommended by the doctor, and everything was smooth and comfortable. The doctor was very attentive, kind, and approachable , it was easy and pleasant to communicate with her.

I had the most wonderful experience with Rapheepan Clinic throughout my entire pregnancy and delivery.

Dr. Rapheepan guided my pregnancy from the very beginning, and I always felt safe, supported, and truly cared for. She is calm, highly professional, and very confident in her decisions — which gave me so much trust during such an important time in my life.

My labor was extremely long — 35 hours of contractions — and it was not easy. With another doctor, I am quite sure I would have ended up with a C-section. But Dr. Rapheepan gave me the opportunity to continue naturally. She monitored everything carefully, supported me patiently through the process, and when necessary, we made the decision to break my water. Thanks to her experience and steady guidance, I was able to give birth naturally.

I am deeply grateful for that.

Now I happily bring my daughter for regular pediatric checkups at the clinic as well. It feels comforting to stay with the same team who supported me throughout my pregnancy journey.

Highly recommended for any mother looking for professional care with genuine heart and dedication. 💛

Dear ladies, I strongly advise against using this clinic's services. I contacted them with questions about my reproductive function, wanted to get tested, have my hormonal levels assessed, and was planning a pregnancy. At the very first consultation, they immediately offered me several options for planning a pregnancy, including ovulation stimulation, and many other options, assuring me that they specialize in reproductive function. After the tests and hormones (my levels were fine, except for low AMH), we moved on to ovulation stimulation, and there were so many nuances that it became clear they had no experience in this area, and their desire to help me was more likely a profit motive. But I was already taking hormonal medications. The main points: I wasn't seen by a single doctor; out of five appointments, I only saw two different doctors, and those were different doctors. The other appointments were with nurses and an intern (but they always charged full fees for the doctor's visit, even for a short consultation with the intern). During the follicle stimulation phase, the doctor ignored my requests to pay attention to my short cycle and to have a follow-up ultrasound to assess follicle growth (before the hCG injection). I was scheduled for a period well after ovulation, even though hCG should be administered before ovulation. I insisted on two additional ultrasounds. The ultrasounds showed low endometrial levels. I was refused prolactin support or other medications during the second phase of stimulation twice. At the follow-up and most important ultrasound to assess follicle growth, an intern was present and told me he was not competent to evaluate the images. I waited over an hour while they consulted with a doctor in Bangkok. After the hCG injection, I was given no advice about the consequences, normal discharge, or anything else, despite repeatedly asking for my appointments to be addressed and endometrial growth support to be performed after the hCG injection. Later, when I expressed my concerns, they treated me rudely and suggested I go to a specialized clinic for IVF before the procedure was even completed. After the hCG injection, they didn't interact with me at all, never asking how the pregnancy stimulation process went, how I was feeling, whether there were any side effects, etc. I then consulted with other doctors. While this stimulation likely resulted in fertilization, the fetus didn't attach to the endometrium, and I had prolonged bleeding. Doctors at other clinics, including Bangkok Hospital, confirmed that the ovulation stimulation process had been carried out with several violations and that this clinic was not competent in matters of reproductive function. Unfortunately, I received reviews about the clinic from other women and expats too late. Furthermore, the clinic insisted on me buying vitamins and supplements from them, as a matter of course. I was very nervous, realizing that I was taking hormonal medications without proper support and supervision from doctors. It took me time to recover physically and mentally. I really hope my review will help someone avoid a similar experience.
